added.title: Director, Software Engineering
added.description:
EngRadar / Element Biosciences

Director, Software Engineering

Element Biosciences

Element Biosciences empowers the scientific community with more freedom and flexibility to accelerate our collective impact on humanity through next-generation life science products.

Element Biosciences
is the employer — EngRadar is a job radar, not a recruiter. We track this posting from their own careers page and send you straight there; we never handle applications or CVs.

San Diego - Headquarters Posted 1d ago biotechlifesciences

Apply directly →

At Element Biosciences, we are passionate about our mission to empower the scientific community with more freedom and flexibility to accelerate our collective impact on humanity. We have built a highly efficient product-driven organization where employees can learn, grow, and thrive in a challenging but encouraging environment. We are committed to scientific integrity, collegiality, honesty, objectivity, and openness.

We're hiring a Director of Software Engineering
to lead a team of developers building the software that powers our multi-omic instruments and platforms. Your team's surface area spans frontend, backend, cloud services, instrument software, CLI/API, and agentic tooling -- across customer-facing products and internal tools that keep the rest of the organization moving fast. This is a hands-on Director role. You'll spend roughly 60% of your time as an IC -- writing production-grade code, driving architecture, and running design reviews -- and 40% managing, mentoring, and growing your team. You'll set direction across the full stack, own delivery for your team's products, and act as the connective tissue between product, chemistry, hardware, and adjacent software teams. Our software supports both research and regulated markets, so you'll need to move fast where you can and hold the line on design controls and V&V where it matters.

We're an AI-forward org. Our engineers use Cursor, Claude, and other AI tooling daily, and we're actively rolling out agentic SDLC workflows across the software function. You'll be expected to champion and shape that adoption for your team. You are a senior technical leader who has shipped production-grade software across the full stack, is comfortable getting hands-on in any layer, and has a track record of building and growing high-performing engineering teams. You bring grit, a bias for action, and a can-do attitude when things get hard. This role will report to our VP, Software and will be a daily onsite role in San Diego, CA.

If you possess the following and want to make a meaningful impact, we invite you to explore this role.

Essential Functions And Responsibilities

Lead, mentor, and grow a team of software developers spanning frontend, backend, cloud, and instrument software
Set technical direction, define priorities, and align team execution with company goals and product roadmaps
Own hiring, 1:1s, performance reviews, career development, and resourcing decisions for the team
Foster a culture of ownership, quality, collaboration, and continuous improvement
Manage team budget, capacity planning, and cross-team dependencies; partner with peer leaders across Informatics, AI, Product, Hardware, and Chemistry
Champion and roll out agentic SDLC practices -- Cursor, Claude, and AI-driven workflows -- across your team, into the broader software org, and help shape best practices for the larger company
Contribute to overall software processes, practices, training, and quality/security assurances for the software department
Contribute hands-on across the stack: frontend (React), backend (Go), cloud services (AWS), workflow orchestration (Temporal), instrument software (Ubuntu), and CLI/API, and agentic tooling
Drive architecture and design for customer-facing products and internal tooling; run design reviews and set the bar for production-grade code, testing, and observability
Own end-to-end delivery for one or more product areas -- from requirements through deployment and sustaining
Partner with product owners, chemistry, hardware, and adjacent software teams to translate multi-omic workflows into scalable, performant software
Debug hard cross-system issues, root-cause complex bugs, and jump in on customer-blocking problems when needed
Prototype quickly with AI tools to validate ideas, pressure-test specs, and de-risk approaches before they reach the team
Advocate for the engineering systems, tools, and workflows that accelerate long-term product velocity
Support both research-market and regulated software development within your team's scope
Own or oversee design controls, verification and validation documentation, risk analysis, and traceability for regulated products (IEC 62304, ISO 13485, IVDR, FDA 21 CFR Part 820)
Partner with regulatory affairs and QMS teams to support audits, inspections, and submissions

Education And Experience

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Bioengineering, or related field (advanced degree preferred)
10+ years of software engineering experience, with 3+ years directly managing engineering teams
Track record shipping production-grade software across the full stack -- frontend, backend, cloud services, and workflow orchestration
Hands-on fluency with our stack or close equivalents: Go, React, MongoDB, Redis, gRPC, GraphQL, Temporal, Ubuntu, AWS
Daily fluency with AI coding assistants (Cursor, Claude, or similar) and demonstrated experience introducing or scaling agentic SDLC workflows within a team
Experience shipping software that spans instrumentation, cloud SaaS, and CLI/API tooling
Strong analytical, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills; comfortable presenting to executives, customers, and technical stakeholders
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment while balancing IC contribution and team leadership
Experience with life sciences, multi-omic, DNA sequencing, or scientific instrumentation software
Experience with regulated software workflows -- IEC 62304, ISO 13485, IVDR, or FDA 21 CFR Part 820 -- including design controls, traceability, and V&V documentation for SaMD or instrument software
Experience shipping ML/AI features -- traditional ML pipelines and/or LLM/agent-based features (RAG, tool use, evals)
Cross-organizational or inter-company collaboration experience

Physical Requirements

Must be flexible in working hours as this position may require customer support during non-regular business hours

Location:

San Diego – on-site

Travel

List amount of travel required or anticipated, if any.

Job Type

Full-time, Part-time, Exempt/Non-exempt

Base Compensation Pay Range

$180,000 - $254,000

In addition to base compensation noted above, you will be eligible for stock options, discretionary annual bonus, no cost health insurance plans, 401k with company match, and flexible paid time off.

Please note: Base compensation will depend on multiple factors, including geographic location, qualifications, and experience.

We foster an environment such that all people are afforded the freedom to pursue their passions without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, gender (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, veteran status or any other characteristics protected by law.

added.title: Sr. Director, Software Engineering, Digital for Research & CMC Development
added.description:
The Role

We are seeking a Senior Director of Software Engineering to lead the software engineering organization supporting Research and CMC Development. Reporting to the Head of Digital for Research and CMC Development (D4RT), this leader will establish clear engineering standards and operating rhythms, drive accountability and predictable execution, and build a high-performing organization capable of delivering reliable, scalable digital solutions that advance scientific research and development.

This leader will oversee full-stack application and integration engineering capabilities, leading and developing engineering leaders and senior technical contributors while strengthening engineering practices across the organization.

The ideal candidate combines deep software engineering experience with strong operational and people leadership. They bring the technical credibility to effectively lead senior engineers, evaluate system-level tradeoffs, and develop exceptional technical talent. While this is not a hands-on development role, this leader will bring strong systems thinking, understand the broader implications of technical decisions, and empower technical leads and other senior contributors to provide technical leadership across the organization.

The successful candidate will also have significant experience within biotechnology or biopharmaceutical organizations and a strong understanding of scientific Research and CMC Development environments. They will understand the scientific context, workflows, ways of working, and cross-functional dynamics required to translate complex scientific needs into effective digital and software strategies.

Here’s What You’ll Do

Software Engineering Operations

Lead the evolution of the software engineering organization, establishing the leadership practices, operating model, engineering standards, and talent capabilities needed to support a growing Research and CMC Development digital portfolio.
Build and develop strong engineering leaders and senior technical contributors, enabling them to grow talent, delegate effectively, establish clear ownership, and operate at the right level of technical and organizational leadership.
Establish clear and consistent expectations for performance and career progression across the engineering organization, creating transparency around what strong performance looks like and how individuals grow in scope and impact.
Establish effective engineering operating rhythms and portfolio management practices that provide visibility into priorities, capacity, resource allocation, commitments, delivery health, dependencies, and risks, enabling informed tradeoffs when demand exceeds capacity.
Build a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and ownership in which teams deliver against commitments, leaders address systemic barriers to delivery and meaningful improvements to engineering practices and ways of working.

Application & Integration Engineering

Provide senior oversight across custom full-stack application and integration engineering capacities supporting scientific and operational workflows.
Guide engineering strategy across commercial SaaS platforms, custom applications, scientific systems, enterprise platforms, and data products, promoting reusable APIs, services, integration patterns, and shared capabilities.
Drive simplification and sustainability across the technology landscape, ensuring applications and integrations leverage sound cloud architecture and engineering practices and are designed with reliability, observability, security, scalability, and operational support appropriate to their use.

Partner with Product Management

Partner with Product Management to maintain alignment across product priorities, planned initiatives, engineering capacity, and existing commitments, enabling effective resource planning and informed portfolio tradeoffs.
Bring an engineering and systems perspective into product planning, helping teams understand how proposed solutions fit within the broader digital ecosystem and when software engineering capabilities are needed.
Develop engineering leaders who can partner effectively with Product leads, while working across D4RT leadership to strengthen Product–Engineering ways of working, shared planning, and decision-making.

Partner Across Digital

Build strong partnerships across Digital, including Data Engineering, DevOps and Cybersecurity to navigate shared priorities and dependencies and effectively leverage enterprise platforms, data products, standards, and expertise.
Bring an informed engineering perspective to cross-Digital initiatives and enterprise technology decisions, understanding their implications for Research and CMC Development and constructively influencing approaches where needed.

Drive Scientific & Operational Impact

Build trusted relationships with leaders and stakeholders across Research and CMC Development, developing a deep understanding of scientific workflows, development processes, data flows, and decision-making needs to inform engineering strategy and priorities.
Translate complex and sometimes ambiguous scientific needs into pragmatic, scalable digital solutions that improve scientific and operational outcomes.

Here’s What You’ll Need (Basic Qualifications)

15+ years of progressive software engineering and technology experience, including 10+ years of engineering leadership experience with responsibility for engineering teams, leaders, and senior technical contributors.
10+ years of experience in software engineering, including significant hands-on experience designing and delivering production software, with strong technical depth across modern software architecture, cloud-native engineering, full-stack development, APIs, distributed systems, and enterprise integration patterns.
5+ years of modern cloud architecture and cloud-native engineering principles, with experience evaluate architectural approaches and tradeoffs across complex software environments.
10+ years of leadership experience within biotechnology or biopharmaceutical organizations, with direct experience supporting scientific Research, CMC Development, Technical Development, Process Development, or closely related R&D functions.
Demonstrated experience leading and scaling software engineering organizations, including developing engineering leaders and senior technical talent, evolving engineering operating models and practices, and driving strong organizational performance.

Here’s What You’ll Bring to the Table (Preferred Qualifications)

Experience with scientific and laboratory technology ecosystems, including ELN, LIMS, SDMS, laboratory automation, scientific data platforms, modeling or analytical systems, or related capabilities.
Experience integrating commercial scientific SaaS platforms within complex biotechnology or biopharmaceutical technology environments.
Experience applying AI-enabled engineering tools and practices to improve software development productivity, quality, and scalability, with the technical fluency to guide engineering teams on effective and responsible adoption.

Pay & Benefits

At Moderna, we believe that when you feel your best, you can do your best work.
That’s why our benefits and well-being resources are designed to support you—at work, at home, and everywhere in between.

Competitive healthcare, plus voluntary benefit programs to support your unique needs
A holistic approach to well-being, with access to fitness, mindfulness, and mental health support
Family planning benefits, including fertility, adoption, and surrogacy support
Generous paid time off, including vacation, volunteer days, sabbatical, global recharge days, and a discretionary year-end shutdown
Savings and investments to help you plan for the future
Location-specific perks and extras

The salary range for this role is $210,900.00 - $379,200.00. This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. An individual’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, performance, and business or organizational needs. The successful candidate may be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, other incentive compensation, or equity award, subject to company plan eligibility criteria and individual performance.

About Moderna

Since our founding in 2010, we have aspired to build the leading mRNA technology platform, the infrastructure to reimagine how medicines are created and delivered, and a world-class team. We believe in giving our people a platform to change medicine and an opportunity to change the world.

By living our mission, values, and mindsets every day, our people are the driving force behind our scientific progress and our culture. Together, we are creating a culture of belonging and building an organization that cares deeply for our patients, our employees, the environment, and our communities.

We are proud to have been recognized as a Science Magazine Top Biopharma Employer, a Fast Company Best Workplace for Innovators, and a Great Place to Work in the U.S.

If you want to make a difference and join a team that is changing the future of medicine, we invite you to visit modernatx.com/careers to learn more about our current opportunities.

Our Working Model 

As we build our company, we have always believed an in-person culture is critical to our success. Moderna champions the significant benefits of in-office collaboration by embracing a 70/30 work model. This 70% in-office structure helps to foster a culture rich in innovation, teamwork, and direct mentorship. Join us in shaping a world where every interaction is an opportunity to learn, contribute, and make a meaningful impact.

Moderna is a smoke-free, alcohol-free, and drug-free work environment.

Equal Opportunities

Moderna is committed to equal employment opportunity and non-discrimination for all employees and qualified applicants without regard to a person's race, color, sex, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, ancestry or citizenship, ethnicity, disability, military or protected veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, marital or familial status, or any other personal characteristic protected under applicable law.Moderna is a place where everyone can grow. If you meet the Basic Qualifications for the role and you would be excited to contribute to our mission every day, please apply!

Moderna is an E-Verify Employer in the United States. We consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Accommodations

We’re focused on attracting, retaining, developing, and advancing our employees. By cultivating a workplace that values diverse experiences, backgrounds, and ideas, we create an environment where every employee can contribute their best.

Moderna is committed to offering reasonable accommodations to qualified job applicants with disabilities. Any applicant requiring an accommodation in connection with the hiring process and/or to perform the essential functions of the position for which the applicant has applied should contact the Accommodations team at leavesandaccommodations@modernatx.com.

added.title: VP AI Technology, Innovation & Delivery
added.description:
Regenerons Enterprise Data & AI organization is newly established and moving fast built to drive AI transformation and adoption at scale across every part of the enterprise. This is a high-visibility, high-velocity position where the work is directly tied to business and scientific impact.

The Vice President, AI Technology, Innovation and Delivery is the first hire into this function. This leader establishes Regeneron's AI architecture foundation, stands up the engineering capability, and builds the practice before leading it. Accountable for translating frontier AI capabilities into production-grade solutions, this role defines the enterprise AI architecture vision, stands up Forward Deployment Engineering, and owns the AI innovation engine from horizon scanning to proof-of-concept to scaled deployment. As the organization matures, this leader will lay the groundwork for future sub-function leaders across architecture, engineering, and innovation.

The role works in close partnership with the Data & AI Engineering leader in Regenerons Global Capability Center (GCC) in India, where build and operate resides. Together, they ensure that what is designed is architected for platform-scale delivery and built to last.

This position reports to the SVP Chief AI Officer.

Core Responsibilities

Agentic AI Strategy & Platform Evaluation

Defines and owns the enterprise AI architecture vision, design patterns, and technical standards across Regeneron. Sets enterprise direction for agentic AI, evaluating and selecting platforms, frameworks, and architecture patterns. Strategy and platform selection reside in this role; build and operate sit within the GCC.
Determines where Regeneron builds, buys, or partners for agentic AI capabilities, ensuring strategic alignment with the GCC for build-and-operate execution.
Translates business problems into solution blueprints, architecture patterns, and integration pathways, owning design decisions from concept through prototype with production-grade rigor.

Enterprise AI Product Management

Leads a team of product managers and product owners accountable for Regenerons portfolio of enterprise AI capabilities. Each capability has a defined owner, a roadmap, and adoption metrics, ensuring AI solutions are treated as products, not projects: with clear business sponsors, measurable outcomes, and a path to sustained value.

Emerging Technology & Industry Intelligence

Tracks the AI frontier across models, platforms, agentic frameworks, and methods, and translates that intelligence into concrete recommendations tied to Regenerons business and scientific priorities.
Maintains a clear view of how AI is advancing across biopharma and life sciences and identifies where emerging capabilities can solve real problems or unlock new opportunities. Runs structured pilots with clear adoption criteria.

Forward Deployment Engineering

Stands up Regenerons Forward Deployment Engineering capability from the ground up. Deploys cross-domain squads that embed directly with business and scientific stakeholders to accelerate priority use cases. Operates in two modes: rapid deployment of configured GenAI and low-code/no-code solutions and structured prototype-to-handoff engagements for higher-complexity problems requiring GCC production engineering.
Defines the squad model, deployment playbook, and engagement standards, establishing the operational distinction between rapid-deployment and build-to-scale modes from day one.

People & Organizational Leadership

Builds, develops, and leads a multidisciplinary organization spanning product managers, applied AI engineers, solutions architects, and forward deployment engineers. Sets the technical bar, develops senior talent, and holds the organization to measurable outcomes.
Partners with GCC engineering leadership to ensure solutions are buildable, scalable, and maintainable at platform level. Defines and governs handoff standards between applied AI prototypes and GCC production engineering.
Represents applied AI to senior leadership across the enterprise. Partners with peers across Enterprise Data & AI to ensure delivery is integrated with data, MLOps, and governance functions.

Qualifications

BS/BA degree in a related field required.
20+ years leading applied AI/ML organizations through the full lifecycle opportunity identification, architecture, prototype, and production handoff.
Demonstrated experience building and leading AI product management organizations establishing product ownership, roadmaps, and adoption accountability for enterprise AI capabilities.
Strong product mindset paired with hands-on solution architecture depth; able to operate as both strategist and technical leader not a pure people-manager.
Deep appreciation for the life sciences context an understanding of how AI is reshaping drug discovery, clinical development, regulatory, and commercial functions in biopharma, and a genuine appetite to engage with Regenerons science. This orientation is essential to earn credibility with Regenerons scientific and operational leadership.
Deep familiarity with the current AI landscape: generative AI, agentic systems, LLM application architecture, retrieval and reasoning patterns, and modern AI/ML platforms.
Hands-on familiarity with low-code/no-code AI deployment and configured GenAI platforms; able to recognize when a business problem calls for rapid configuration versus custom engineering and build a team that executes both modes with equal discipline.
Proven track record building and scaling reusable AI capabilities across a complex enterprise.
Experience partnering with distributed engineering organizations; successful experience designing-to-handoff with a GCC team in India or similar global delivery model is strongly preferred.
Ability to communicate and influence effectively across Digital Technology groups, business units, and the GCC team in India.
Strong people leadership; experience leading leaders and building senior technical organizations in a competitive market.
Demonstrated executive presence and enterprise influence. Track record shaping AI strategy at the senior leadership level and building organizational credibility across scientific, commercial, and technology functions.

Company Overview

NWN is the leading AI-powered technology solutions provider for North America's most innovative public and private organizations. For more than 30 years, NWN has helped over 5,000 CIOs deliver technology modernization programs with its Intelligent Workplace, Customer Experience (CX), Managed Devices, Cybersecurity and Public Safety, Connectivity, and Intelligent Cloud solutions. The company's proprietary Experience Management Platform ensures seamless service delivery, real-time observability and improved efficiency for its clients' most demanding technology needs. NWN is a high-performance, high-integrity team of 1,000+ experts committed to a customer-obsessed culture, earning a 75 Customer Net Promoter Score. The company has been recognized with hundreds of industry awards and is proud to be a 'Best Place to Work' with an 86 Employee Net Promoter Score. For more information, visit: NWN.ai.

Responsibilities

This role of Director of IT Sytems
leads a team responsible for the NWN ServiceNow platform
. The team is responsible for ServiceNow platform operations and support, and ongoing enhancements and new capability implementations for business optimization and workflow automation. This is a management role leveraging software development and implementation experience. The ServiceNow platform is used to deliver and manage customer-facing services while also supporting internal service operations across more than 15 teams. While the platform primarily supports internal team users responsible for managing services delivered to customers, it is also leveraged to provide customer users with access to platform capabilities which help them manage their services, view relevant information, and engage with supported service workflows.

Manage ServiceNow platform operations, platform support, ongoing enhancements, and new capability implementations for business optimization and workflow automation.
Collaborate with executive stakeholders to define platform strategy, including strategic visioning, roadmap planning, and prioritization.
Translate platform strategy into actionable delivery plans that align with business goals and platform standards and manage the execution.
Manage the implementation of new capabilities on ServiceNow, leveraging platform native solutions when feasible and building custom solutions when necessary.
Manage and enforce platform governance frameworks, including design authority, change control, and development standards.
Lead the team in following SDLC process using Agile methodology, and implement policies and procedures related to design, analysis, testing, and coding for implementations on the platform.
Ensure adherence to security compliance, including data governance and role-based access controls
Own and lead platform performance and service outcomes, defining and monitoring KPIs (e.g., availability, reliability, and service delivery) and driving continuous improvement.
Build, lead and develop a high-performing team, including performance management and career development.
Oversee resource planning and capacity management to balance operations with strategic platform initiatives
Recommend technical and business process improvements
Create sustainable systems and services through automation

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in computer science or related discipline
10+ years Experience in systems applications; programming and/or managing
5 years Experience building solutions using Agile methods
Experience building enterprise solutions following a SDLC
8+ years supervisory experience required
Experience managing a team of developers
Ability to translate strategic vision into tactical plans to achieve desired outcomes
Ability to plan and manage work backlog using Agile methods, including platform operations, platform support, ongoing enhancements, and new capability implementations.
Ability to lead a team and drive business outcomes
Ability to elicit requirements (user/stakeholder, business, functional) from business needs presented
Proactive approach to identifying problems, performance bottlenecks, and areas for improvement
Ability and desire to skill up on new technology and capabilities
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Experience with ServiceNow and Power BI
Ability to establish and enforce platform governance, including design authority, change control, development standards, security compliance, and role-based access controls
Ability to manage team capacity, resource planning, performance expectations, career development, and continuous improvement across operational and strategic platform initiatives
Demonstrated comfort with adopting emerging AI tools and technologies to optimize processes, improve collaboration, and drive operational effectiveness.

added.title: AI Digital Product Sr Manager  Agentic Platform (REMOTE)
added.description:
Join Amgens Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like youre part of something bigger, its because you are. Our shared missionto serve patients living with serious illnessesdrives all that we do.

Since 1980, weve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the worlds toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, youll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, youll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

AI Digital Product Sr Manager Agentic Platform (REMOTE)

What You Will Do

Lets do this. Lets change the world. In this vital role you will be an AI Digital Product Sr Manager
within Enterprise AI & Data Science to lead the strategy, execution, and evolution of Amgen's Enterprise Agentic Ecosystem
Platform
. This developer-centric platform enables AI engineers, software engineers, data scientists, and citizen builders to rapidly build, deploy, govern, and scale enterprise AI agents that accelerate scientific discovery, streamline R&D workflows, and improve enterprise decision making.

You will own the product strategy for a secure, cloud-native AI platform that provides reusable services, SDKs, APIs, orchestration, developer tooling, observability, and governance. Working cross-functionally with engineering, platform architecture, Responsible AI, security, and business teams, you will deliver a world-class developer experience while ensuring enterprise-grade security, compliance, and Responsible AI.

Lead Product Ownership for Enterprise Agentic Platform: Act as the Product Manager within an Agile framework, ensuring that AI platform products meet the needs of customers and align with the organization's strategic goals. Drive the evolution of a reusable enterprise Agentic Ecosystem that includes agent orchestration, memory, tool integration, model routing, identity, observability, deployment services, and governance capabilities.
Champion an exceptional developer experience and Platform Strategy by simplifying AI agent development through reusable SDKs, APIs, templates, documentation, reference implementations, self-service capabilities, and internal developer tooling. Translate business needs into technical requirements and prioritize initiatives to increase impact.
Scale Enterprise AI: Lead the end-to-end lifecycle of AI initiatives from discovery through enterprise scale, identifying reusable platform capabilities that accelerate adoption while optimizing reliability, scalability, latency, and AI inference costs.
Own platform health and adoption metrics including product usage, active builders, developer experience, platform adoption, model quality, reliability, latency, cost efficiency, Responsible AI compliance, and customer satisfaction.
Drive Responsible AI and Quality: Establish governance, guardrails, evaluation standards, and policy enforcement in partnership with Responsible AI, Security, Privacy, Legal, and Enterprise Architecture. Define evaluation frameworks for quality, safety, reliability, latency, hallucination risk, cost, and business outcomes.

What We Expect Of You

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The professional we seek is a AI Digital Product Sr Manager
with these qualifications.

Basic Qualifications

Experience in leading products, defining roadmaps and tracking the success of the product.
Strong technical fluency with cloud-native software platforms and the ability to collaborate effectively with software engineers, AI engineers, platform engineers, architects, data scientists, and business stakeholders. Excellent critical thinking, problem solving, and communication skills,
Masters degree and 6 years of Product/AI/Information/Tech Systems experience OR
Bachelors degree and 8 years of Product/AI/Information/Tech Systems experience OR
Diploma and 12 years of Product/AI/Information/Tech Systems experience

Preferred Qualifications

8+ years of product management or related experience, including 5+ years delivering AI/ML, developer platform, cloud platform, or enterprise software products.
Experience building or managing enterprise AI platforms, developer platforms, platform-as-a-product, or shared platform capabilities that enable internal or external developers.
Strong understanding of LLMs, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agent orchestration, model serving, AI evaluation, and ML productization in enterprise environments.
Experience with modern AI and cloud technologies such as AWS, Databricks, MLflow, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph, AutoGen, or comparable AI development platforms and frameworks.
Experience with cloud-native architectures, APIs, SDKs, microservices, event-driven systems, and modern software engineering practices, with the ability to partner effectively with engineering teams on technical architecture and product decisions.
Experience defining and measuring developer experience, platform adoption, product analytics, customer success metrics, and platform health, using data to drive product decisions and prioritization.
Experience establishing or partnering on Responsible AI, security, privacy, governance, and compliance practices for enterprise AI platforms, including guardrails, policy enforcement, and evaluation standards.
Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience presenting product strategy, technical vision, and business outcomes to senior leadership.
Hands-on experience using experimentation, telemetry, observability, and customer feedback to improve platform adoption, product quality, and user experience.
